concerns.text: FR-001 and FR-003 require a deterministic synthetic generator (seed=42) as the primary data source. Task T011 ('Generate deterministic synthetic baseline data') is marked as unchecked `[ ]` and the Analyze report flags it as 'REJECTED' due to missing artifacts. Without this task being executable, the entire pipeline (US1, US2, US3) lacks its mandatory primary input, violating FR-001.

FR-007 mandates outlier clipping at the 99th percentile before statistical tests. Task T021 ('Implement outlier clipping...') is unchecked `[ ]` and flagged as 'REJECTED' in the Analyze report. Downstream tasks (T022, T024, T037, T039) depend on this clipped data. The absence of an executable task for FR-007 leaves the statistical validity of the project unaddressed.

FR-008 requires raising a ValueError if dataset size < 50 rows. Task T022 ('Implement orchestration...') includes this logic but is unchecked `[ ]` and flagged 'REJECTED'. The Analyze report notes a circular dependency where T022 cannot run because T011 (data generation) is missing. This leaves the fail-fast constraint of FR-008 unimplemented.

FR-002 requires engineering interaction features (e.g., `cold_work * Mn_content`) and including `annealing_temp_K` as a standalone predictor. Task T024 ('Implement interaction feature engineering...') is unchecked `[ ]` and flagged 'REJECTED'. Without this, the core hypothesis (pinning effect) cannot be tested, violating FR-002 and Constitution Principle VI.

FR-003 requires training a Random Forest Regressor. Task T029 ('Implement Random Forest Regressor training...') is unchecked `[ ]` and flagged 'REJECTED'. This blocks the core predictive capability (US2) and prevents the generation of the model artifact required for US3 (Statistical Significance).

SC-006 requires comparing MAE against a threshold derived from the baseline mean. Task T032 ('Implement held-out test set evaluation...') is unchecked `[ ]` and depends on T012 (baseline stats) which is also 'REJECTED'. The success criteria for the model cannot be evaluated without this task.

FR-005 and SC-002 require a Permutation Test to verify interaction significance (p < 0.05). Task T039 ('Implement Delta-Permutation Test...') is unchecked `[~]` (partially done/failed) and depends on T037/T038 which are also 'REJECTED'. The primary research question regarding the 'pinning effect' cannot be answered.

FR-006 and SC-003 require SHAP Interaction Value analysis. Task T041 ('Implement SHAP Interaction Value analysis...') is unchecked `[~]` and depends on T030 (model) and T024 (features), both of which are 'REJECTED'. The requirement to identify key drivers via SHAP is unmet.

SC-002 and SC-003 require reporting the p-value and interaction importance. Task T042 ('Generate statistical_significance.json') is unchecked `[ ]` and depends on T039/T040. The project cannot report the statistical validation required by the spec.

SC-008 requires the generation of the feature importance list and p-value report. Task T043 ('Generate shap_interaction_report.json') is unchecked `[ ]` and depends on T041. The deliverable for US3 is missing.

The plan requires an end-to-end validation (quickstart). Task T056 ('Run quickstart.md validation') is unchecked `[ ]` and depends on a chain of 'REJECTED' tasks (T011, T021, T024, T029, etc.). The pipeline cannot be verified as functional.

Task T019 is marked with `<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->`. While the task description exists, the 'FAILED' tag suggests a prior review issue that hasn't been resolved or clarified in the task description itself. The task should be updated to explicitly state the resolution or be re-evaluated for coverage.
